Scenario: policy moderation block (oracle "moderation" section). The
moderation_response.blocked==true flag is recorded in state (complete event
carries Blocked=true) and the assistant refusal prose that follows IS visible
text — it streams as an assistant_delta and is part of the final answer
("I can't assist with that request."). The caller decides the
content-policy mapping; the stream never treats a blocked turn as an error.
